title: Networking primer for AWS
summary: Master the networking vocabulary AWS interviews test first: Internet Protocol (IP) addresses and Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnets, Domain Name System (DNS) with Route 53, Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificates, public versus private networking, Network Address Translation (NAT) and routing gateways, and how Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) layers map to AWS services.

topics.title: IP addresses, CIDR, and subnets (address planning)
DNS and Route 53 fundamentals (names to endpoints)
Public versus private networking (internet-facing vs internal)
NAT, routing, and gateways (egress without inbound exposure)
OSI layers mapped to AWS services (where each service sits)
